notes: Player-milestone registry for the Zilla 3.0 pilot (MLB career HR). Merges ZILLA_3_MASTER_RULEBOOK_v0.1_DRAFT with the approved section 13 decisions of 2026-10-22. rules_v1.json and rules_v2.json are kept unchanged as history.
changes_from_v2: Rule IDs follow the master rulebook draft (M-PRIME, M-REVPRIME, OPP-TYPEA, JERSEY-EXACT, DN-EXACT, BIRTH-SPAN-EXACT, KW-EXACT); M-INDEX added as an annotation.
M-REVPRIME no longer excludes palindromes: it qualifies whenever reverse(M) is prime.
JERSEY-EXACT is symbolic; BIRTH-SPAN-EXACT is calendar/biographical.
Every comparison carries a status: QUALIFIED_STRUCTURAL, QUALIFIED_CALENDAR, SYMBOLIC_NOTE, NO_HIT, INVALID, UNVERIFIED, RULE_CONFLICT.
Gematria sources come only from the approved phrase registry (city, nickname, city+nickname). Bare supplied numbers are no longer accepted.
Feb 29 birthdays: birthday-anchored spans are UNVERIFIED in non-leap years (observance pending).
Moon, zodiac and keyword overlays are opt-in. Moon requires the event start time.
TRIPLE_PRIME_SYNC is NOT_EVALUATED until an independence rule is locked; PRIME_CLUSTER is always flagged DEPENDENCY_REVIEW_REQUIRED.
The control test moved out of the decode into the separate research command.
The milestone is derived as current_count + 1; v0.1 implements career scope only.
3.1.0: stat codes are registered. HR is the approved pilot stat; H and RBI are trial stats, labeled in every output.
3.2.0: source policy is manual or an approved adapter with operator sign-off; mlb-statsapi@0.1.0 approved.

statuses.QUALIFIED_STRUCTURAL: exact hit of a structural rule from a verified source
statuses.QUALIFIED_CALENDAR: exact hit of a calendar or biographical rule
statuses.SYMBOLIC_NOTE: exact hit of a symbolic rule; never structural evidence
statuses.INVALID: comparison not allowed (source outside the phrase registry or the event)
statuses.UNVERIFIED: input missing or rule pending; nothing was guessed
statuses.RULE_CONFLICT: two rule versions disagree; the match is withheld

decisions.source_policy: manual or approved adapter with operator sign-off (2026-10-22)
decisions.pilot_stat: MLB career HR (approved); career H and RBI as trial stats
decisions.leap_day_birthdays: pending: birthday-anchored spans UNVERIFIED in non-leap years
decisions.pigr_sources: every eligible source value (phrase gematria, jersey, birthday spans, calendar codes, weekday/planet gematria); each hit names its source family

conventions.gematria: Letters only, case-insensitive; digits, spaces and punctuation count as zero. Ciphers: EO (a=1..z=26), FR (EO digit-reduced), RO (a=26..z=1), RR (RO digit-reduced), CH (Chaldean).
conventions.prime_index: 1-based: 2 is the 1st prime, 23 is the 9th prime.
conventions.reverse_digits: Base-10 digit reversal of an integer; leading zeros drop (100 -> 1). Not the same thing as the Reverse Ordinal cipher.
conventions.DN2: month + day + each digit of the year (10+21+2+0+2+6 = 41)
conventions.DN3: every digit of month, day and year (1+0+2+1+2+0+2+6 = 14)
conventions.DN5: every digit of month, day and two-digit year (1+0+2+1+2+6 = 12)
conventions.birthday: Exact calendar arithmetic from birth date to the local event date. An event-day birthday gives days_since = 0 and days_until = 0. Spans are distinct anchors.
conventions.moon_phase: algorithm meeus-ch49 (true phases, dT = 69 s). Requires event_start_local and timezone; the phase name is judged over the local calendar day and the moon age at the start time.
conventions.zodiac: Fixed tropical sun-sign table: Aries 3/21, Taurus 4/20, Gemini 5/21, Cancer 6/21, Leo 7/23, Virgo 8/23, Libra 9/23, Scorpio 10/23, Sagittarius 11/22, Capricorn 12/22, Aquarius 1/20, Pisces 2/19.
conventions.control_test: Research only: the same verified sources decoded against alternative milestones within +/- window of M.

forbidden: concat, SACB/EACB, power-chain, square/Fibonacci and mirror bridges (experimental, off)

mlb-statsapi@0.1.0.output: draft snapshot with per-field URL and fetched_at_utc; never decoded until attested
